title: SoA Consolidation Corrections Schema
description: Human decisions on a protocol's cross-table activity matches, and on which main column a subsidiary column sits within. One file per protocol, next to the consolidated file; consolidation reads it before matching. Entries name source rows (table_number + activity_id, with activity_name as a check) or source columns (table_number + column_position, with composite_label as a check), never unified ids, which are not stable across input changes. The Layer 3 analogue of soa-table-corrections.

schema_version.description: Schema version. 1.1 adds op 'within', whose source and target are columns. Files stamped 1.0 remain valid.

protocol_id.description: Protocol whose consolidation this sidecar corrects.

id.description: Entry identifier, unique within this file (e.g. 'ccorr-001').

op.description: keep=consolidation's result for the pair stands: 'source' stays merged with 'target', or stays separate from its near match 'target'; split='source' is taken out of the unified activity it shares with 'target' and becomes an activity of its own; merge='source' joins the unified activity of 'target'; refines='source' (a row or a whole table) details the row 'target', nothing is merged; within='source' (a column of a subsidiary table) is a timepoint taken within the visit of the column 'target' of a main_soa table, nothing is merged and the source column stays in its own segment; one entry per source column and main column, and a column without an entry is unknown (nothing is derived from header text). An entry whose premise no longer holds (a row renamed, a 'keep' or 'split' of a merge that no longer happens, a 'merge' that now happens by itself) stops consolidation.

source.description: The row the decision is about: the later-consolidated row of the pair. For 'refines' it may be a whole table (table_number only). For 'within' (only): the subsidiary column.

target.description: The other row of the pair: a row of the unified activity 'source' is merged with, kept apart from, taken out of, joined to, or refines. Its table must be consolidated before the source's table. For 'within' (only): the column of a main_soa table the source column sits within.

corrections.description: The decisions, one entry per pair of rows (for 'refines': per row or table and the row it details; for 'within': per subsidiary column and main column).

activity_id.description: activity_id of the row in that table.

activity_name.description: The row's activity_name, carried as a check: it must equal the name in the resolved table.

row.description: A source row: one activity row of one resolved table.

activity_id.description: activity_id of the row in that table. Absent when a whole table is meant ('refines' only).

activity_name.description: The row's activity_name, carried as a check.

row_or_table.description: A source row, or a whole resolved table when only table_number is given ('refines' only).

column_position.description: column_position of a data column (not the label column) in that table.

composite_label.description: The column's composite_label, carried as a check: it must equal the label in the resolved table.

column.description: A source column: one data column of one resolved table ('within' only).
